title: One finding of the launch contract
description: One entry of `findings` of the launch contract (feature 107). The severities and the statuses are the members of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 79 that annex G §G.8 gives (the record schema `launch-contract.schema.json` of @specstride/contracts names them); the severities and statuses are read from that table, never copied by hand. The draft holds exactly one bootstrap finding, `semantic-derivation-required`, with the fixed message and resolution text (F107-FR-005); an open blocker refuses promotion (F107-FR-021). A finding that an answer to a judgment item wrote carries the provenance of the answer (F107-FR-010).

id.description: The id of the finding; `semantic-derivation-required` for the bootstrap finding

severity.description: The severity; a member of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 79, as annex G §G.8 gives it

status.description: The status; a member of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 79, as annex G §G.8 gives it

source.description: Where the finding stands: the path, the line and the anchor

path.description: The path of the source, relative to the repository root

anchor.description: The anchor: the id the line carries, else the anchor of the record

resolution.description: The resolution; the fixed text for the bootstrap finding, the text that names what resolved it for a finding an answer wrote

provenance.description: The provenance of the answer, for a finding that the answer wrote (F107-FR-010)

who.description: The host or the harness that answered

route.description: The route of the answer; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 260 (routeOfAnAnswerToAJudgmentItem of @specstride/contracts)
